title: Introduce Lean Econ Curator and batch/cache trimmer
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds an automated 'lean econ' curator that proposes conservative batch/cache defaults and a cache-trimmer that safely reduces in-memory KV state for long-tail tenants; exposes a small CLI for per-tenant dry-run and export of unit economics profiles.
description: Context: customers running mixed short/long sequences see variable unit economics and some tenants accumulate large KV caches that drive memory spikes. Motivation: provide an automated, conservative layer that recommends batching and cache defaults per-tenant and trims stale KV entries without impacting tail latency. What this PR does: 1) Introduces the 'lean-econ-curator' service component that ingests recent request signatures, sequence-length histograms, and hit-rate snapshots and synthesizes safe defaults for batch_size, max_prefill, and kv_retention windows. 2) Adds a 'batch-cache-trimmer' background worker that runs per-tenant soft-trims (age-aware eviction + size soft-limits) and emits signals for graceful rollback if latency rises. 3) Ships a small CLI (redwood econ audit) that allows SEs to run dry-runs, preview recommended defaults, and export candidate quantization profiles to the unit-econ dashboard. 4) Implements a conservative quantization prescriptor: it ranks candidate qprofiles using a safety score (loss estimate + quality delta on a holdout prompt set) and only suggests profiles with score >0.9 by default. Design notes: the curator acts in advisory mode by default, writing recommendations to tenant metadata; the trimmer uses a two-step approach (soft eviction then hard trim after monitoring window) to avoid regressions. Telemetry: new metrics (econ.recommendations.count, econ.trimmer.evictions, econ.qprofile.safety_score) and tracing spans for curator decisions. Rollout plan: start as tenant opt-in in Canary region, run curator in dry-run for 48h, enable trimmer with 0.1% of tenants, increase to 5% after stability checks. Testing: unit tests for recommendation heuristics, integration tests against the runtime in the perf lab (synthetic mixed-short-long workload), and a 24h smoketest in Canary. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration harness updated, [x] metrics and traces implemented, [x] CLI docs draft, [x] dry-run mode default, [x] feature flag gated. Related: ENG-2240 (tenant-level econ defaults), ENG-2251 (prefill memory reclamation).
